decision: How should SSD - MCDB scenarios be selected
options: A: exclude MCDB from the first release / B: expose MCDB Total with the same 2 Low Volume scenarios / C: expose MCDB Organic with a Not specified placeholder
recommendation: A for the first release; MCDB adds no value to the Boon slice and its scenario column is blank

decision: Is DBType a fourth control or a separate Scenario
options: A: exclude byDB tables / B: add a DBType control after Granularity / C: fold DBType into the Scenario label
recommendation: A for the first release; adding a fifth control complicates the cascade for a metric that is already forecast-only

decision: How many forecast versions to extract
options: A: N=1 latest only / B: N=3 / C: N=5
recommendation: B with N=3 for true version columns; for HDD forest use the latest run per scenario because execution_time is not a version

options: A: 6 months back and 12 forward / B: 12 back and 24 forward / C: full history
recommendation: B; it yields approximately 1.55M rows for phase 1 and keeps the Viewer meaningful

options: A: single extraction of everything / B: phase 1 HDD and SSD-Phoenix then phase 2 CPU and IOPS
recommendation: B; phase 1 is 1.55M rows and unblocks the Boon deliverable while phase 2 waits for R5b

decision: How to handle the HDD forest run stamp
options: A: expose execution_time as a version / B: use the latest run per scenario and hide the stamp / C: derive a daily version from the stamp
recommendation: B for the first release; C is the long term fix but needs validation

decision: Should SSD Type Total vs TotalPerturbed be a control
options: A: fix to Total / B: expose as a control / C: expose both series
recommendation: A for the first release; TotalPerturbed is 19.4M of 26.7M rows and its meaning is unconfirmed

decision: Is NAMPRD07 the mandatory demo key
options: A: yes for HDD forest and SSD-Phoenix / B: no mandatory key
recommendation: A; NAMPRD07 is confirmed present in both and matches the reference portal

decision: What happens with the blank ModelVersion in hdd_region
options: A: drop the 46490 rows / B: bucket them as Unspecified / C: treat them as forecast
recommendation: B; dropping data silently is not acceptable and C would be an invention

decision: What storage format replaces flat CSV
options: A: CSV / B: parquet / C: duckdb
recommendation: Deferred to R5b; phase 1 at 1.55M rows may survive CSV but phase 2 at 6.02M will not
